basics.name: Ming Zhong
basics.label: Senior Data Scientist
basics.summary: Self-motivated Senior Data Scientist with 5+ years of experience in the retail industry. Expertise leveraging analytical techniques to transform data into business intelligence. Proven track record of collaborating across teams in agile framework, developing ETL pipelines, and providing data-driven solutions to drive business growth and operational efficiency.

work.name: Circle K Stores Inc.
work.summary: Leading data science initiatives for retail site selection, financial forecasting, and pricing optimization.
highlights: Developed and deployed a dashboard powered by multiple ML models to identify similar stores in existing network for financial forecasting, enabling Real Estate teams to effectively analyze key drivers and site comparability.
Built and deployed random forest models to predict ROI in 220K+ block groups, identifying 15K+ high-potential locations and narrowing real estate planning efforts in US and Canadian markets.
Enhanced revenue prediction accuracy by 15% through the development of a random forest regression model, preventing potential real estate investment failures exceeding $2M in the Texas sector.
Segmented stores using clustering algorithms such as DBSCAN, Spatial, PCA, k-means on site, demographics, transactional data to identify similar local markets within each business unit.
Designed and implemented A/B testing to measure the impact of price changes for Cigarettes in test stores which resulted in a margin uplift of $700,000 across the Midwest region.

work.name: Circle K Stores Inc.
work.summary: Focused on demand forecasting, pricing optimization, and ETL pipeline development.
highlights: Predicting carwash demand using various forecasting models like Prophet, ARIMA, RNNs, and LSTM enabled stakeholders to optimize supply chain and pricing, resulting in cost savings exceeding $500k.
Led migration of pricing solution from Databricks notebooks to Azure Cloud environment with Azure Data Factory, reducing runtime by 88% (70 hours) and cutting costs by 76% ($500).

Estimated price elasticity for each SKU using Unobserved Component Model (UCM) for time series forecasting to optimize product pricing strategies, resulting in a 3% average margin lift (over $120M in gross margin) annually.
Engineered data pipelines to track the state of the storage and ensure data quality for modeling and business purposes, eliminating over 60 hours of manual labor per quarter.

work.name: ROKT Corp.
work.summary: Provided analytical support for attribution modeling, COVID impact analysis, and NLP applications.
highlights: Evaluated attribution identifier performance using SQL and recommended including phone numbers in the attribution model, driving a 40% increase in ad conversions.
Created Tableau COVID Recovery Dashboards tracking more than 10M transactions for 10+ major clients, providing critical insights for relaunch decisions for ad campaigns.
Developed an NLP-powered chatbot in Google Chat using Python and NLP libraries (spaCy, NLTK) to answer client campaign performance questions, winning first place in the company's hackathon.

work.name: Roche Holding AG
work.summary: Developed R tools and visualizations for clinical research.
highlights: Developed an R package with data cleaning functions, cohort balancing using propensity scores, multiple hypothesis testing, and visualization for real-world evidence (RWE) data, which is used by 3+ researchers.
Enhanced, deployed and maintained an R Shiny App to visualize multidimensional patient time series data to help gain clinical insight, making it easy to share clinical result among teams.
